note: Copy, then replace every coordinate with ones read from grid views of YOUR photo. Delete the parts you do not use.
x and y are picture pixels. `edge` follows the visible outline in the order references/body-parts.md gives.
`toward` is a point INSIDE the body part. `width` is the part's own width in pixels (or two points).
Names in English: the check pictures cannot draw other scripts.

parts.name: jaw left
parts.note: cheekbone level -> below the mouth corner; stop before the chin

parts.name: cheek under hair
parts.note: only where hair borders the face: eye level -> mouth level

parts.name: eye left
parts.note: at = pupil; width = eye corner to corner

parts.name: upper arm left outer
parts.note: top of the shoulder -> just before the elbow

parts.name: elbow left
parts.note: only when the arm is bent: round the tip, from where the upper arm edge ended to where the forearm edge starts

parts.name: forearm left outer
parts.note: elbow end -> wrist end; stop before a cuff or watch

parts.name: waist left
parts.note: top -> bottom, on over the hip; toward = the middle of the waist at its narrowest height

parts.name: thigh left outer
parts.note: hip (or hem) -> just above the knee

captions.name: title
captions.note: one box per line of text printed on the picture; delete when there is none
